title: Revolución o anticomunismo
goal: Read how Cold War logic polarized Latin American politics into revolution versus anticommunism, the military's National Security Doctrine, and the radicalization it triggered on the left.

items: Explain what the Cuban example and Cold War logic pushed regional politics toward.
Describe the National Security Doctrine many militaries adopted.
State what could be interpreted as a step toward communist revolution under this logic.
Explain why armed struggle began to seem like the only realistic option to many activists.
Use no cabe duda de que + indicative to assert a claim with confidence.
